At 19 months two wake-ups are common but fixable — the usual culprit is a sleep association (nursing, rocking) that Remy needs you to recreate each time he stirs. Try a consistent wind-down, put him down drowsy but awake, and when he wakes at night give him a few minutes before going in so he can practice settling himself.

Want the full night-by-night plan for Remy? Reply YES and I'll send it.
